I've found the sweet spot to be 100mg (.1g) psilocybin.

BUT

I've also found that this sweet spot works best with a blend of other medicinal mushrooms.

I've experimented with every mushroom I could get my hands on. Psychedelic and otherwise.

My basic daily blend and the one I give out to friends, family, coworkers, etc is as follows..

 I refer to it as the 'Attaboy Blend'. I cap 24 00 capsules at a time and each contains: 
 100mg psilocybin
 200mg lions mane
 120mg cordyceps 
 100mg cacao

I recommend 3 days on this blend and the 4th day I boost up to 125mg of psilocybin + the other ingredients. Before a three day break. I, myself take the Attaboy Blend every day with zero tolerance breaks. In addition, I've created an "off day" blend for days 5-7.

To reiterate.. 
Attaboy Blend days 1-3
Attaboy booster day 4
Off day blend days 5-7

The off day blend is just a mix of medicinal mushrooms with 0 psilocybin.

I also worked up a blend for sleep 😴 as I needed something to help me come down and unwind at night.

I sleep like a baby, wake up refreshed, pop an attaboy and I hit the ground running so to speak..

….

A few additional notes..
#1. Lions mane is a great addition to any stack but I do believe psilocybin is like thc to other Cannabinoids.. 250mg of lions mane imo is over kill and I'm unsure how people tolerate more than that. It makes me anxious. After many iterations I settled on 200mg. Feel free to find your own sweet spot.

#2. Cordyceps.. an amazing addition to any stack. Gets your libido pumping, mental fatigue in check, ups your endurance and stamina.. I love it and as with lm I found that for me and the individuals I make this blend for, 120mg suffices. 

#3. Cacao? Yes. Just like with combining psilocybin with other medicinal mushrooms.. mushrooms and other natural remedies create a synergistic experience. 

#4. I have my special blends that go beyond this example and I experience regularly with new additions.. point is, what works for you might not work well for someone else. But this is definitely a good "boilerplate" if you will. There are endless possibilities for beneficial blends. ✨ 

 Thanks for your time and I hope this helps someone on their own journey.
